description: List stored SEC filings and earnings-call transcripts newest first. Omit ticker for a market-wide feed or provide one ticker for a company-specific list. Returns company identity, document IDs, types, filing and reporting dates, SEC item numbers, line counts, EDGAR accession numbers and acceptance times (UTC; blank for filings stored before October 2026), and page totals. Supports date, document-type, and exact SEC item-number filters. Hidden document types remain excluded unless explicitly requested. When the deployment summarizes documents, each row adds a one- or two-sentence summary of what the document says, and when it has a public document viewer, each row adds the filing's page URL to share with the user. Pass a returned ID to SearchDocument or ReadDocumentLines.

documentType.description: Document type filter: a registered value such as 'TenK', 'TenQa', 'EightK', 'TwentyF', 'Def14A', 'Defa14A', 'SThree' or 'TenderOfferThirdParty', or its SEC form name ('10-K', '20-F/A', 'DEFA14A', 'S-3ASR', 'SC TO-T', 'NT 10-Q'), plus deployment-registered types such as EarningsCallTranscript. An unrecognized value returns an error listing every accepted value.

endDate.description: Optional end date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format

itemNumber.description: Optional exact SEC current-report item number, e.g. 2.02, 5.02, or 1.01.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of documents per page (default: 10)

startDate.description: Optional start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format

ticker.description: Optional company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT); a listing outside the US is MIC:TICKER (e.g. XPAR:AIR), whose list includes its ESEF reports. Omit for all companies.
